Described from the rio Branco in northern Brazil but as currently recognised is widely-distributed throughout much of northern South America including the Amazon system in Peru, Colombia, Ecuador, Brazil (where it's also been recorded from the rio Tocantins and rio Parnaiba) and Bolivia, plus various drainages in French Guiana, Suriname and Guyana, and the rio Orinoco basin in Venezuela and Colombia.
